objects.query: SELECT Code, DataType, Description, Id, Name, Status FROM AttributePicklist WHERE Name LIKE 'DS %' ORDER BY Name ASC
SELECT Abbreviation, Code, DisplayValue, Id, IsDefault, Name, PicklistId, Sequence, Status, Value FROM AttributePicklistValue WHERE Code LIKE 'DS-%' ORDER BY Code ASC

SELECT Code, DataType, DefaultHelpText, DefaultValue, Description, DeveloperName, Id, IsActive, IsRequired, Label, Name, PicklistId, SourceSystemIdentifier, ValueDescription FROM AttributeDefinition WHERE Code LIKE 'DS_%' ORDER BY Code ASC
SELECT Code, Description, Id, Name FROM AttributeCategory WHERE Code LIKE 'DS-%' ORDER BY Code ASC

SELECT AttributeCategoryId, AttributeDefinitionId, Id, AttributeCategory.Code, AttributeDefinition.Code FROM AttributeCategoryAttribute WHERE AttributeCategory.Code LIKE 'DS-%' ORDER BY AttributeCategory.Code ASC, AttributeDefinition.Code ASC
SELECT Code, Id, Name, Status FROM ProductClassification WHERE Code LIKE 'DS-%' ORDER BY Code ASC

SELECT AttributeCategoryId, AttributeDefinitionId, AttributeNameOverride, DefaultValue, Description, DisplayType, Id, IsHidden, IsPriceImpacting, IsReadOnly, IsRequired, Name, ProductClassificationId, Sequence, Status FROM ProductClassificationAttr WHERE ProductClassification.Code LIKE 'DS-%' ORDER BY Name ASC

SELECT BasedOnId, ConfigureDuringSale, Description, Family, Id, IsActive, IsAssetizable, IsSoldOnlyWithOtherProds, Name, ProductCode, StockKeepingUnit, Type FROM Product2 WHERE StockKeepingUnit LIKE '5%' OR StockKeepingUnit LIKE '6%' ORDER BY StockKeepingUnit ASC

SELECT AttributeCategoryId, AttributeDefinitionId, AttributeNameOverride, DefaultValue, Description, DisplayType, Id, IsHidden, IsPriceImpacting, IsReadOnly, IsRequired, Name, Product2Id, ProductClassificationAttributeId, Sequence, Status, AttributeDefinition.Code, Product2.StockKeepingUnit FROM ProductAttributeDefinition WHERE AttributeDefinition.Code LIKE 'DS_%' ORDER BY Product2.StockKeepingUnit ASC, AttributeDefinition.Code ASC
SELECT Id, Name, SellingModelType FROM ProductSellingModel WHERE Name IN ('One-Time', 'Evergreen Annual', 'Term Annual', 'Term Based - Quarterly') ORDER BY Name ASC
SELECT Id, Name FROM ProrationPolicy ORDER BY Name ASC

SELECT Id, IsDefault, Product2Id, ProductSellingModelId, ProrationPolicyId, Product2.StockKeepingUnit, ProductSellingModel.Name FROM ProductSellingModelOption WHERE (Product2.StockKeepingUnit LIKE '5%' OR Product2.StockKeepingUnit LIKE '6%') ORDER BY Product2.StockKeepingUnit ASC, ProductSellingModel.Name ASC
SELECT CatalogType, Code, Description, EffectiveEndDate, EffectiveStartDate, Id, Name FROM ProductCatalog WHERE Code LIKE 'DS-%' ORDER BY Code ASC
SELECT CatalogId, Code, Description, Id, IsNavigational, Name, ParentCategoryId, SortOrder FROM ProductCategory WHERE Code LIKE 'DS-%' ORDER BY Code ASC

SELECT CatalogId, Id, IsPrimaryCategory, ProductCategoryId, ProductId, ProductCategory.Code, Product.StockKeepingUnit FROM ProductCategoryProduct WHERE ProductCategory.Code LIKE 'DS-%' ORDER BY ProductCategory.Code ASC, Product.StockKeepingUnit ASC
